description: Capability for the main window. R133 · pruned to the five permissions the frontend actually calls: the event/read-only window surface arrives through `core:default`, `updater:default` and `process:allow-restart` carry the update path, and the two window writes the app performs are `setSize` (launcher height) and `scaleFactor` (PTY cell metrics). The zero-call grants this file used to hand the webview are gone — every window show/hide/minimize/close/focus/position/drag action is either Rust-owned (its own command) or already inside `core:window:default`, and the removed plugin sets had no frontend caller at all.
